title: Interactive Proofs as a Unified Framework for Evaluating and Leveraging Verifiable Proof Generation by LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.33676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in LLM-assisted theorem proving and program verification have attracted widespread attention. Beyond determining whether a proposition is true, LLM agents must produce evidence that can be independently checked by humans or formal verification tools. To evaluate the underlying, protocol-agnostic ability of LLM agents to construct verifiable proofs-rather than their proficiency with any particular proof language or verification tool, we introduce Merlin-Bench. Drawing on interactive proof systems from computational complexity theory, we cast an LLM agent as the prover: under a designated protocol, the agent interacts with a formal verifier to substantiate its claimed answer to a problem instance. We develop an automated framework for constructing test cases and use it to create 100 cases across 15 problem families, each formulated within this prover-verifier framework. translated_title: 交互式证明作为评估与利用LLM智能体可验证证明生成的统一框架
translated_abstract: LLM辅助的定理证明与程序验证的最新进展引起了广泛关注。除了判断命题是否为真之外，LLM智能体还必须产出可供人类或形式化验证工具独立核查的证据。为了评估LLM智能体构建可验证证明的底层协议无关能力，而非其对任何特定证明语言或验证工具的熟练程度，我们提出了Merlin-Bench。借鉴计算复杂性理论中的交互式证明系统，我们将LLM智能体设定为证明者：在指定的协议下，智能体与形式化验证器进行交互，以证实其对某个问题实例所声称的答案。我们开发了一个自动化测试用例构建框架，并利用它创建了横跨15个问题族、共100个案例的测试集，每个案例均在此证明者-验证者框架下构建。我们对10个前沿LLM在多种智能体设置下进行了实验……
tldr: 该论文提出Merlin-Bench，借鉴计算复杂性理论中的交互式证明系统，让LLM智能体作为证明者与形式化验证器交互，从而以协议无关的方式评估其生成可验证证明的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Merlin-Bench, which draws on interactive proof systems from computational complexity theory to cast LLM agents as provers interacting with formal verifiers, thereby evaluating their protocol-agnostic ability to generate verifiable proofs.
